installCommand: if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then ROOT="$(pwd -P)"; elif [ -f ../pyproject.toml ]; then ROOT="$(cd .. && pwd -P)"; else echo 'pyproject.toml not found in . or ..'; exit 1; fi; cd "$ROOT" && uv pip install --system --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm ci
buildCommand: if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then ROOT="$(pwd -P)"; elif [ -f ../pyproject.toml ]; then ROOT="$(cd .. && pwd -P)"; else echo 'pyproject.toml not found in . or ..'; exit 1; fi; cd "$ROOT/frontend" && npm run build && mkdir -p "$ROOT/public" && cp -r dist/* "$ROOT/public/"
